shortDescription: Reusable membership review screen composition for new registrations.
fullDescription: Composes the new membership registration review interface shown before payment, including the step rail, personal data summary, contact details, address, secondary membership cards, top capture action, floating quick-action button, and footer actions. The component is structured from reusable section title, detail grid, and secondary member card primitives so future membership-related views can reuse the same review layout patterns from the reference image 1777781281647-hz7g5mgy2b8.jpeg.

shortDescription: Secondary membership form screen linked to a primary member.
fullDescription: Displays the membership registration form for adding a new secondary member under an existing primary membership. The view includes the branded top header, primary member context, left progress rail, personal data section with photo placeholder, contact verification inputs, address fields, footer navigation actions, and the floating quick-action button while using the shared NewSecondaryMembershipForm component to match reference image 1777781280362-0m1yd6qajlo.jpeg.

shortDescription: Reusable membership locator hero with action cards and search form.
fullDescription: Renders the membership access interface with a branded top bar, two large action cards, explanatory copy, and a centered search field for locating member profiles by name, phone, email, or membership number. The component supports active and inactive action-card states and can be reused by membership-related views that need a lightweight customer lookup entry screen.

shortDescription: Shared Radix dialog wrapper with optional built-in close control.
fullDescription: Provides the reusable modal primitives used across the application, including overlay, portal, content, header, footer, title, and description helpers. The dialog content now supports an optional showCloseButton prop so views can hide the default top-right close button when supplying a custom control or matching a tightly designed modal layout.

shortDescription: Reusable membership verification modal with member rows and code entry boxes.
fullDescription: Renders the compact membership verification dialog from reference image 1777781279681-hbeprvw275k.jpeg, including the icon header, explanatory copy, verified and pending member rows, four-slot code entry placeholders, resend links, and a primary Done action. The component is designed as a reusable membership flow modal for confirming multiple contacts by phone number or email while keeping row status presentation consistent across future verification-related screens.

shortDescription: Membership verification screen shown as a centered modal over a dimmed background.
fullDescription: Displays the verify memberships experience as a centered modal dialog over a muted backdrop, matching the provided reference. The view uses the shared MembershipVerifyDialog component to present member contact rows, verification states, code entry placeholders, resend actions, and the final Done button for completing contact confirmation.

shortDescription: Reusable secondary membership entry form with sectioned membership fields.
fullDescription: Renders the full secondary membership data-entry layout with a branded top bar, primary member summary, single-step side rail, section headings, compact form controls for personal data, contact verification rows, address inputs, footer action buttons, and a floating shortcut button. The component is reusable for future membership onboarding screens that need the same structured multi-section form presentation from reference image 1777781280362-0m1yd6qajlo.jpeg.
